decision_rule: A lower observed joint failure rate with no observed increase in normalized answer errors is only a candidate interface improvement on this panel. Null, mixed or worse results are retained without retuning or expansion.
intervention: Marker prompts are byte-identical to their parent prompts. Bare prompts remove FINAL: from both map lines and use the exact bare-only final instruction fixed by this generator. Evidence, cue, docket, answer map and expected answer remain unchanged.
launch_requirements: frozen implemented scorer and boundary tests
pinned execution plan with complete no-retry failure receipts
motivation: GPT-6 Luna run: all 112 answers correct under frozen parser, but 26 bare outputs and 8/56 format-repeat differences; question selected after observing these outputs.
order: repeat blocks 0 then 1; within each, ascending SHA256 of canonical [scope, repeat, case_id]

scoring_contract.answer_correct: Normalized answer equals expected_answer; unresolved is false.
scoring_contract.format_compliant: After outer whitespace stripping: marker condition requires exactly FINAL: A or FINAL: B; bare condition requires exactly A or B. A wrong but well-formed symbol is still format-compliant.
scoring_contract.input: query_id and output_text only; complete unique 96-slot run required
scoring_contract.joint_success: answer_correct AND format_compliant; unresolved is false.
scoring_contract.normalized_answer: Reuse parent parse(text, response_mode), accepting bare A/B or exact FINAL: A/B after outer whitespace stripping only; all other output unresolved.
scoring_contract.reporting: Counts and descriptive paired contrasts only; no independent-n=96 inference, significance claim, general reliability or internal mechanism attribution.

selection: All r0 standard/inverted parent cases; full tasks restricted to baseline layout; all mapping-only cases retained. Selection does not depend on individual output correctness or formatting.
unit: Two reused content instances; all factorial slots and repetitions are dependent. Pair formats within parent_case_id and replicate_id. This is not a new independent content sample.
